FN-A51F7SQ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 45
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative Ed Oliver
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/30/2025
House Bill 45 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Medicaid Agency by
an agency-estimated $4.7 million annually, consisting of $3.7 million in federal funds and $1
million in state funds, by providing coverage for certain noninvasive colorectal cancer screening
tests.

FN-A51F7SQ-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 45
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Representative Ed Oliver
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/25/2025
House Bill 45 as passed the House of Representatives would increase the obligations of the
Alabama Medicaid Agency by an agency-estimated $4.7 million annually in fiscal years 2026
and 2027, consisting of $3.7 million in federal funds and $1 million in state funds, by providing
coverage for certain noninvasive colorectal cancer screening tests.
